name: Strategy 4
description: Strategy 2 with one change: a CHoCH needs a candle to CLOSE beyond the protected level (and beyond the AVWAP for a trend flip) instead of touching it. Everything else as Strategy 2 — 5-minute candles, swings / BOS by touch, stop at the CHoCH candle.
